agent_explanation: Shrunk case has heavy body0 (m=19.3, e=0) falling to rest on floor (y=r at step31) while light fast body1 (m=1, e=0.645, vy≈-26) collides obliquely from above. Between step30 and 31 the solver resolves simultaneous ground-contact and body-body contact in same substeps (22-25 substeps, dt~0.0246). Instead of at most partially restituting the incoming vertical kinetic energy, it injects large spurious horizontal velocity into the heavy body (vx -1.93 → +38.4), raising total energy from ~1065 J to 14653 J (>5× initial 2435 J, controller_work=0). This is classic positional-correction / sequential-impulse double-counting for a resting contact + incident collider with mass ratio ~19:1 and non-zero restitution. Setting e=0 on the incident body removes the restitution impulse branch and eliminates the gain, confirming restitution/contact handling as cause.
